name: LNG ship's steel structure enclosure benchmark
description: Reproducibility bundle accompanying the paper "A reciprocity-preserving iterative normalization algorithm for numerically computed view factor matrices in enclosure radiation" (Eswara and Sandilya, 2025). Contains raw view factor matrices, per-iteration convergence histories, meshes, metadata, FreeFEM source code, analysis scripts, and a dependency-free pass/fail verification harness (workflow/run_workflow_caseC.py) for Cases A-D of the LNG ship's steel structure enclosure benchmark.
